content: Mɛlkisɛdɛk, mfum anà ngaŋ
Mɛlkisɛdɛk awà kàkäl mfum a Salɛm anà ngaŋ a Nzam a Dudu. Nde mbuur kàkàbwey anà Abàlam, umpal kàfü Abàlam ità u ntsü kàwɛl nde iböŋ udu a amfum, waa kun'si an'kɔɔ.
Abàlam kun'pɛ mwɛy unsà indiir kwem kàwɛl nde kà ità kàböŋ nde. Mutàsɛmà, ikɔb a Mɛlkisɛdɛk iswaŋà naa « mfum a balàbal ». Nde sye wà mfum a Salɛm, iswaŋà naa « mfum a duu ».
Nde wà mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n taarànde, itàkal ngwän, itàkal un'lwaaŋ, itàkal nsɛmà, itàkal ntsüü a mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛɛ nde wà asànaa Mwan a Nzam, nde wà ngaŋ ipepey.
Làtääŋ kölàköl a mbuur awà, waa undweer a mbuur Abàlam kun'pɛ mwɛy unsà kwem a indiir kàwɛl nde.
Kyekà, un'kɔɔn apaa nswɛɛŋ akà Alɛvi abà angaŋ muwal mwɛy unsà kwem akà un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl, iswaŋà naa akà atɔŋ aba abà baar a ywar a Abàlam.
Wɛɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk mbuur mpa kàkäl mbuur a ywar a Lɛvi, nde kàwɛl mwɛy unsà kwem akà Abàlam anà nde kàsi ŋilää an'kɔɔ.
Kyekà, mukɔɔn asà mbaaŋ, mbuur awà udu afàsà mbuur awà ungyɛl an'kɔɔ.
Kyekà, baar a ywar a Lɛvi bàfàwal mwɛy unsà kwem, ba bà baar akwà, wɛɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk wà mbuur bàtɛ imbäl naa nde we anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Mumay, bi ban'kwo mutɛn naa: Lɛvi mbuur afawalà mwɛy unsà kwem kàkyer apà mwɛy unsà kwem u mbwo a Abàlam.
Ntɔn, itàkal naa nde kàkäl aŋàtun'bɔr anki, nde kàkäl asànaa wà paa amu nkaa ande Abàlam, umpal kàbwey nde anà Mɛlkisɛdɛk.

Yàlàkal naa isal bàfàkölà u mbwo a ingaŋ a alɛvi, ntɔn kya kyà kiin a Un'kɔɔn bàpɛ akà un'sɛŋ, yàlàfàkal anki anà ndöŋ mutwey ngaŋ asin unsà un'lwaaŋ a Mɛlkisɛdɛk, akwànaa mukun'sɔɔl uboo a un'lwaaŋ a Alɔn.
Ntɔn, nsɔɔmà a ingaŋ ifàtwaal nsɔɔmà a un'kɔɔn.
Wɛɛ indiir abi byanswà byàtɛɛnà ntɔn mbuur awà mbuur a mbil asin, uboo a ya akà mbuur mwɛy kàtàkyer anki ingaŋ u mɛsà a ibɔɔn.
Ntɔn bàkyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa Mwol abi kàfü u mbil a Yuda, mbil mpa kàtɛn Mɔsɛ indiir ntɔn ingaŋ.
Ngaŋ asin asànaa Mɛlkisɛdɛk
Yan'mɛnà u leŋ naa we anà ngaŋ asin kàtoo asànaa Mɛlkisɛdɛk.
Nde kàbulà anki ngaŋ ntɔn nswɛɛŋ a un'kɔɔn a ikyee imbuur, wɛɛ u mbwo a ngwal a mɔ̈ɔ̈ mpa afàkwà.
Ntɔn bàtɛ imbäl ki ntɔn nde:
Abun, un'kɔɔn wàtàtwɛb bàkyàdwa, ntɔn wa kàkäl anki ngwal anà ndöŋ
anà kàsyen anki akà mbuur mwɛy u nköölà. Wɛɛ u ntsü yumwɛy làkyän aŋàsöön ubwaŋ làkyàyà. U mbwo a la, bi ifàsin tsütsü apà Nzam.
Apà làkäl anà kyän a Nzam. Baar bamwɛy bàbulà angaŋ ukɔɔn kyän a tub alà.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàbulà ngaŋ unsà kyän, mpal kàtɛn Nzam a nde naa:

content.text: "Ngye awà ngaŋ a mbul a in'tye." »

content: Kyakin, Yɛsu kàbulà mbööl a nkwà aŋàbwaŋ.
Yumwɛy, angaŋ a alɛvi bàkäl mbɔɔn ntɔn ukwà bapɛɛ anki mbwo mukal ipepey unsà isal.
Wɛɛ, ntɔn Yɛsu wà mbul a in'tye, ingaŋ ande kyà ipepey.
Kyakin, nde kan'kwo mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ipepey baar bàfàsin tsütsü apà Nzam u mbwo a nde. Ntɔn nde we ana mɔ̈ɔ̈ taaŋ lanswà ntɔn muyamà ntɔn ba.
Yɛsu wà undweer a angaŋ awà kan'kwo anà bi, wàŋin'kyɛɛl, twan latɛy, ube batɛy, wàŋàkaabà anà baar a man'be, bun'sɛɛn u dudu u du.
Nde kà wà anki asànaa andweer a angaŋ bumwɛy bàfàpà ibɔɔn ilä byanswà, utàtwɛb ntɔn man'be aba ŋakwo, ungö ntɔn un'sɛŋ. Wɛɛ nde isal aki kàkyer ipepey mbalà mwɛy mupà nde ŋakwo.
Andweer a angaŋ abà bàfàsà Un'kɔɔn bà baar a gyɔ̈ɔ̈là. Wɛɛ ndaa a kyän bàtɛn ungö a un'kɔɔn yàsi Mwan mwɛy wàŋàkwo mbul a in'tye.
